template_data.lead_html: The pricing mistake I watch companies make every single week.

rows.what_html: Prices inflated 20–30% — to 'leave room' for negotiation
CO benchmarks against commercial invoices — the gap gets flagged immediately
4–8 weeks of rework — resubmission, second review, delayed approval

template_data.closer: INFLATED PRICES DON'T PROTECT YOU. THEY DELAY YOU.
